description_sq:

 Prona ka nje organizim teper funksional: 2 dhoma gjumi, kuzhine+sallon ;koridor shperndares te te gjitha dhomave; 2 tualete , ballkon me dalje nga dhoma dhe dhoma e ndenjes ;.

description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in Kashar, near Casa Italia, with a construction area of ​​139.5m2, with regular documentation from the company, on the 6th floor of a new building with an elevator. The property has a very functional organization: 2 bedrooms, kitchen + living room; distribution corridor to all rooms; 2 toilets, balcony with exit from the room and the living room;. Property specifications: The apartment will be provided invested by the company with: parquet, hood system, thermal insulation, hydrosanitary incaso, plastic windows with triple glazing.
